section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of body satisfaction using the Body Areas Satisfaction Subscale (BASS) from the Multidimensional Body-Self Relations Questionnaire (MBSRQ). The 9-item measure assesses satisfaction with various body parts on a 5-point scale, with the Brazilian Portuguese version showing adequate psychometric properties. The study achieved a Cronbach alpha of .80 for this measure.
